results.title: fors fortuna
results.overview: A celebration of nature on a bright summer day against the sounds and textures of a modern, urban landscape.

results.title: The Glass Magazine
results.overview: Experimental musician and shoplifter, Trudy, arrives at a guardianship building full of eccentrics to take care of a dog in exchange for free accommodation.

results.title: Playing Drunk
results.overview: Documentary film(mast)er Jan visits the (playing) drunk slave HD.

results.title: My Lying Lover
results.overview: The movie is a romantic comedy about a young woman who asks an old actor to pretend to be her wealthy grandfather to impress her fiancé's family.

results.title: Hearts in Colombo
results.overview: In this culture-clash romantic comedy set in Sri Lanka, Rick surprises his girlfriend, Shanaya, by flying halfway across the world to Colombo for Christmas. On his first-ever trip abroad, Rick attempts to win over Shanaya's family but quickly finds himself completely out of his depth.

results.title: Thrift Store Ouija Board
results.overview: Three friends awaken something supernatural through a thrifted Ouija board-only to discover it's far more interested in exposing their secrets than answering their questions.

results.title: Barbara Salesch – Der größte Prozess ihres Lebens
results.original_title: Barbara Salesch – Der größte Prozess ihres Lebens
results.overview: In the 90-minute film “Die Tote im Rhein” (The Dead Woman in the Rhine), Barbara Salesch investigates a mysterious murder case. A missing woman, a dark secret, and two suspects lead to a thrilling hunt for a ruthless perpetrator.

results.title: Truth Rising
results.overview: Truth Rising isn’t just a documentary— it’s a call to action at a critical time in our culture. As faith, identity, and morality are being redefined, this documentary exposes the civilizational moment we are living in. Through powerful stories and expert insights, it reveals how ordinary people can make an extraordinary impact—by boldly choosing courage over fear. As the world redefines truth, Truth Rising offers clarity, courage, and a Christ-centered path forward.

results.title: White House
results.overview: Dé, Adrianim and Martins are three black teenagers from Chatuba, Rio de Janeiro. When Dé receives the news that Almerinda, his grandmother, is in the terminal phase of Alzheimer's disease, he decides to enjoy the last days of her life together with his two best friends.

results.title: Norwegian Mackerel
results.overview: Over ten years ago, their mother passed away after giving birth to the youngest sibling. Not long after, their ailing father also died. Now, with an eviction notice in hand, the four siblings are left with only a letter from their father and a car registration under Chun-ja's name. Chun-ja takes back the car that their uncle had been using. After a family meeting, they agree with Jun-myung, the third sibling, who wishes to take a year off from school to travel. They set off on a camping journey together.

results.title: #love
results.overview: A playful clash of personalities turns into unexpected romance when two young people discover love beyond trends and appearances in Hashtag Love.

results.title: Facing the Monster
results.overview: At the beginning of the 1990s the state of Yugoslavia collapsed, and resistance to the madness of war was strongest in Belgrade, where anti-war actions and movements opposing the Serbian nationalist regime brought together intellectuals, artists, and anti-regime individuals—most notably in a nonpartisan group called the Belgrade Circle. This is a documentary film that portrays the struggle to keep alive the fight for truth and dignity by bravely confronting the crimes committed in the name of the nation.

results.title: A History of Erotic Art
results.overview: The people of Antiquity had little problem with nudity and would not find graphic depictions of sexual acts as morally suspect or obscene. But Christianity changed perspectives, bringing in notions of shame and the negation of the body. This documentary looks at the erotic in art over the last two thousand years.

results.title: Forced Outing
results.overview: A forced outing as sexual fantasy. After 30 years of heterosexual marriage André wants to present himself to the camera and wishes to be outed on the internet against his will. This needs to be discussed and negotiated.

results.title: Nurseries, raid on babies
results.overview: Since nurseries were opened up to the private sector in the early 2000s, early childhood has become a lucrative business for its voracious players. As scandals involving abuse and embezzlement of public funds multiply, we investigate the excesses of deregulation, which has turned babies into cash machines.

results.title: 1C
results.overview: From a small apartment in Buenos Aires, disturbing material was recovered. What begins as a simple documentation of everyday life turns into a dark and nightmarish descent. The discovery of apartment 1C was no coincidence… and you shouldn't look at this poster at night either.
